turns.replyText:
My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
If your tracking shows delivered but you do not have the package, the following steps are recommended:
Check around the delivery location — look around your front door, side door, garage, mailbox area, porch, building reception, or any safe-drop spot.
Ask neighbors or building management — carriers sometimes leave packages with a neighbor, concierge, or mailroom.
Review the tracking details carefully — sometimes the carrier includes a delivery photo or notes about where it was left.
Allow a short delay — in some cases, a package may be marked delivered slightly before it actually arrives.
The shipping page confirms that delivery timing can depend on the carrier, and delays can occur outside our control.
If you would prefer, I can connect you with a human representative for further assistance with a missing delivered package. Please let me know if you require further clarification.
